printed_comparison.3.1_3.2: Source subsection prose reverses Table 3: X1 gives F(s), X2 gives F(t); X2 is outside q>0 domain.
printed_comparison.3.7_3.8: Source subsection ansatzes are reversed. Correct 3.7: alpha*t+F(s), identity; correct 3.8: alpha*s+F(t), alpha*F_ttt=0.
printed_comparison.3.4: Printed cubic power profile and amplitude condition agree exactly, but the normal-form leading coefficient vanishes there; phi grows like t^(2/3) at fixed s>0.
printed_comparison.3.5: Printed (25)--(27) fail exact rational witnesses; source power profile is exact and (27) should have an additional 2*Sigma/3+M denominator.
printed_comparison.3.6_3.9: Printed (29), (31), (33) fail exact rational witnesses. Correct traveling residual is -alpha*dI/dz. Free-particle linearization is valid locally where B(P)!=0; (34) selects I=-1, not the general family.
